catalog_applicability.scope: Static rule applicability to native library declaration buffers; not per-function graph compile coverage.

buffer_and_array_observations.type_descriptor: ARRAY=0x100000 and STRING=0x8000 discard bounds/lengths; preserve the declaration alongside the descriptor.
buffer_and_array_observations.array_compatibility: FX3U custom FLOW_ARRAY graph IN_OUT: equal element type, rank and per-dimension count; lower bounds may differ. Scalar and indexed element operands do not satisfy an array input.
buffer_and_array_observations.string_compatibility: Observed INT_TO_STR_E and STR_TO_INT_E require a typed STRING operand; STRING[3], [6], [12] compile to identical complete PCode at the same address. This does not prove runtime bounds safety.
buffer_and_array_observations.references: Native analysis 3 returns direct graph operands at their printed base address, or the allocated addresses of a typed array label. Neither is an instruction access extent: normal IN_OUT BufferA/BufferB are marked attribute 1 despite compiled copyback; inverted output BufferC lists the whole array despite a one-element CML/DCML.
buffer_and_array_observations.array_port_inversion: Accepted INT[2], INT[3], DINT[2] controls: ordinary bindings copy 2, 3, 4 words via DMOV/BMOV; input inversion uses CML/DCML for one element and copies the result into a temporary without source-array writeback. Output inversion leaves normal source-array copyback and emits a one-element CML/DCML to the explicit array output.

compiler_lowering.scope: Five isolated FX3U fixture controls, ECCompiler_IEC 15.50 x86; source generation of program 1 only. No PLC execution or general instruction coverage claim.

mechanism: The AST type field is the base scalar type even on a direct ARRAY reference. Array count is recovered from the component type behind a direct reference; it is not encoded in that scalar field.
99350 accepts direct node kind 0x10f, resolves component type 0x33, and returns its element count. A NOT wrapper kind 0x16c is not classified as an array.

For NOT(BufferA), a9940 returns count 1. Copyback reaches ab780 with the formal source kind 0x116 and a temporary destination kind 0x11f. The original BufferA reference remains under the earlier NOT expression.

Observed INT[3] copy emits BMOV with K3. DINT[2] copy uses K4; inverted input emits DCML into one DINT temporary and DMOV to that temporary on copyback. No original-array copyback is present in the independent listing.
c5cc0 alone misses name-based library templates. Their records use opcode -2 with the instruction name and reach aed60 directly; ordinary backend records pass through ceef0 first.
At ceef0 entry, record name and operand count may still belong to the previously buffered instruction. At aed60 entry these fields agree with the emitted record.

record_layout.name_handling: native CString pointer; copied to text for observation, raw pointer retained only in raw trace

compiler_lowering.comparison_limits: PCode equality validates that instrumentation preserved this compile. Emission records precede final encoding/optimization; e.g. CALL records become CALLP in these independent native listings. Record names alone are not a complete final-instruction oracle.
